title: Automated Logistics Compliance Auditor
business: Global logistics firms managing complex, multi-jurisdictional shipping regulations.
problem: Manual compliance checks are prone to error and slow, as agents often fail to synthesize dynamic regulatory updates with specific shipment manifests, leading to costly delays.
solution: The ReAct framework enables agents to interleave reasoning traces with tool-based actions, allowing the system to query live regulatory databases and verify shipment data against those findings in a single, transparent workflow.
steps: Define the agent prompt structure to enforce a Thought-Action-Observation loop.
Connect the agent to a secure, read-only API for real-time customs regulation lookups.
Implement a reasoning module that decomposes complex compliance queries into sequential sub-tasks.
Configure the observation parser to feed external API results back into the agent's context window.
Establish a final response generation step that summarizes the reasoning path for human auditability.
outcome: Improved accuracy in compliance verification and increased transparency, as human auditors can review the step-by-step reasoning trace that led to a specific shipping clearance decision.
limitation: The agent may enter infinite loops if the observation data is ambiguous or contradictory; check for this by monitoring the length of the reasoning trace and setting a maximum step threshold.

diagram.title: ReAct Execution Loop
diagram.description: The agent cycles through reasoning and acting until the compliance task is resolved.

nodes.label: Action Generation
nodes.detail: Model selects a tool to call

nodes.label: Observation
nodes.detail: Result is fed back to model

code.content:
def react_step(query):
    thought = model.generate(f'Thought: {query}') # Reasoning trace
    action = model.generate(f'Action: {thought}') # Tool selection
    observation = api.call(action) # External data retrieval
    return f'Observation: {observation}' # Feedback loop
code.explanation: This snippet illustrates the core ReAct loop where the model generates a thought, selects an action, and receives an observation to inform the next reasoning step.
